verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm offering legal advisory services, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is outside its product category. The evidence shows only legal practice areas, published fee information, a UPC decision tracker and an investor-readiness questionnaire tool. None of these is an automation platform, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
